note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of the front photo (39.3 mm case, listing; strap 19.5 / 20.5 mm measured at the slanted top / bottom against 20 mm). Heights before the house depth scale (12.3 mm thick listing). House method: modelled steel case, bezel, lugs, crown and rose-gold hands; the photo map serves only the dial print and the leather strap.

case.note: [kind, offset, z]: round rings about the pivot, 'case' = offset from the 39.3 mm case radius, 'crystal' = offset from the crystal opening (mean of the photo's crystal ellipse, 35.85 mm). Flank, rounded shoulder, wide polished bezel rising inward, inner lip down to the crystal seat

lug.note: one lug, mirrored to all four: outer edge as [depth below the tip, offset out from the inner edge] in mm, mean of the TL, TR and BL lugs of the straight front photo (round 1 trace); tip at 22.4 mm (mean of the photos' 12 and 6 o'clock tips), inner edge 0.05 mm outside the 20 mm strap

dial.note: flat dial (open heart and power reserve are print in the photo) to the minute track, the track a cone up to the crystal ring

hands.note: faceted dauphine hour and minute with short tails, thin seconds needle with a counterweight tail, all rose gold (photo)

crown.note: fluted crown on the 3 o'clock axis: 6.5 mm across, 3.4 mm long (straight front photo)

strap.note: 20 mm, house curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips, 7 mm radius, end = tip + 2.2 x radius; starts under the case. photo_case_edge: where the official render's strap leaves the case on the strap's centre line (mm); photo_past_tip: flat leather kept past the photo's lug tip

steel_polished.note: house polished steel: case, bezel, lugs, crown

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass

review.subtitle: Polished steel, grey open-heart dial with power reserve, rose-gold hands, black croc leather strap. Front relief GLB.
notes: Round 4: rebuilt on Orient's official straight front render (2000 px, sharper and straight on). House method: case, bezel, lugs and crown in the house polished steel, modelled rose-gold dauphine hands; the photo is used only for the dial print and the leather strap.
The model is the real round watch: 39.3 mm case, four equal lugs, crown on the 3 o'clock axis, 20 mm strap.
The applied indices and Roman numerals, the power reserve and the open heart are printed flat on the dial.
The deployant buckle and the strap keeper are left out. The strap curls under at both ends, like the other tracker watches.
